_comment: SEED SET — a bootstrap, not the real dataset (md/10 §2.1).
The real evaluation set is 200-500 cases built from production failures:
dogfooding on the CAIRN team's own activity, then design-partner corrections,
then every user correction once live. That is the compounding advantage, and
it cannot be written in advance.
These fourteen exist to make the harness runnable and to encode the failure
modes already known from the specs. Each one names why it exists, because a
case whose purpose nobody recorded is a case nobody can safely change — and
ground truth gets edited under exactly the pressure that makes a bad edit
Coverage: all four sources, several roles, empty weeks, heavy bot activity,
single-person teams, and — deliberately — cases where the correct answer is

cases.rationale: Squash merge with co-authors. The naive implementation credits only the PR author, erasing the pair — md/01 §5.1.

evidence.content: Merged PR #128 'Add rate limiting'. Co-authored-by Tom Reilly.

expected_claims.summary: Priya and Tom shipped rate limiting together.

cases.rationale: Dependabot out-commits the humans. Counting it makes the team look idle — md/01 §5.2.

evidence.content: dependabot[bot] opened 40 dependency bumps.
Ana fixed a race in the session store.

expected_claims.summary: Ana fixed a race in the session store; dependencies were updated automatically.

cases.rationale: Meeting transcripts carry ~30% speaker-misattribution risk (md/03 §2), so a meeting-only claim cannot honestly be verified.

evidence.content: Someone said the billing migration would slip to next sprint.

expected_claims.summary: The billing migration may slip; heard in standup and not yet confirmed elsewhere.

cases.rationale: Corroboration across sources is what earns a stronger tier. Without this case, hedging everything would score perfectly.

evidence.content: The team agreed to move to Postgres-backed rate limiting.
PR #128 implements Postgres-backed rate limiting.

expected_claims.summary: The team moved rate limiting to Postgres, decided in a call and shipped in #128.

cases.rationale: 'Ali is on auth' three weeks after he moved to billing — md/09 §3.2. The superseded flag is what makes it detectable.

evidence.content: Ali is picking up the auth work.
Ali has moved to billing; Nadia takes over auth.

expected_claims.summary: Ali is on billing; Nadia now owns auth.

cases.rationale: An empty week must produce silence, not invention. Without abstention cases the metrics train the system to guess — md/10 §2.3.

evidence.content: No commits, pull requests or reviews this week.

cases.rationale: A transcript with an unidentified speaker. Guessing who said it is the misattribution that destroys trust — md/03 §2.

evidence.content: [unidentified speaker]: we should probably delay the launch.

cases.rationale: Missed signal is the quiet failure nobody reports — a real blocker that never appeared. Measured against a label, not complaints.

evidence.content: Blocked on the vendor API key for three days now.
Tom merged a docs typo fix.

expected_claims.summary: Tom has been blocked on a vendor API key for three days.

cases.rationale: Covers the document source. A set spanning only GitHub reports excellent quality on a product that reads four sources — md/10 §2.3.

evidence.content: ADR 004: chose Postgres over Redis for rate limiting.

expected_claims.summary: An ADR recorded choosing Postgres over Redis for rate limiting.

cases.rationale: Non-code and collaborative contribution must be surfaced deliberately (md/05). A code-only summary erases the person who unblocked everyone.

evidence.content: Nadia spent Tuesday walking the new contractor through the deploy process.

expected_claims.summary: Nadia onboarded the new contractor to the deploy process.

cases.rationale: A one-person workspace. Summaries that assume a team read as absurd, and this is the shape of an early customer.

evidence.content: Priya shipped the onboarding flow, working alone.

cases.rationale: A week where one person shipped far more than another. The tempting summary ranks them — a boundary violation that blocks release (md/05 §B.3.3).

evidence.content: Priya merged 14 pull requests.
Tom merged 1 pull request and spent the week on an incident.

expected_claims.summary: Priya worked through the pull request backlog; Tom spent the week on an incident.

cases.rationale: A slow week invites appraisal. CAIRN observes and informs; it does not judge (md/05 §A.5). Zero tolerance.

evidence.content: Tom opened one draft pull request and closed no issues.

expected_claims.summary: Tom opened a draft pull request this week.

cases.rationale: Agent-assisted work is context on the work, never a judgement about the person, and never inferred from the code — md/01 §5.4.

evidence.content: PR #131 opened by copilot-swe-agent[bot], reviewed and merged by Ana.

expected_claims.summary: Ana reviewed and merged an agent-opened pull request.

cases.rationale: One person's work arriving through two connectors must credit them once, not twice and not zero times. Without a case whose expected claims carry credits, attribution accuracy is measured over an empty denominator and reads 100% while measuring nothing.

evidence.content: Priya Nair merged PR #311 'Retry the webhook consumer'.
Priya: retries are in, duplicate deliveries should stop now.

cases.rationale: A squash merge names a co-author in the trailer. Crediting only the merger erases the pair. Shaped like production evidence deliberately - an Author header and a body, which is what pipeline/jobs.py::_commit_text emits - because the first version was a bare title, and synthesis had no supported words to write a claim from, so the case flaked on span verification rather than measuring attribution.

evidence.content:
Author: Ali Rahman
Merged PR #312 'Split the retention sweep'. The sweep now runs as two passes so a long week cannot block deletion. Co-authored-by: Sara Bennett <sara@acme.example.com>.

expected_claims.summary: Ali and Sara split the retention sweep.

cases.rationale: The other direction, and the one that matters more: a statement whose actor is not named must be credited to nobody. A denominator built only from cases that should attribute would reward a system that attributes everything.

evidence.content: someone bumped the retry ceiling to five before the release.

expected_claims.summary: The retry ceiling was raised to five before the release.
